in_marathi.name: Kalyaani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalyaani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kalyaani is a Sanskrit name, derived from the word 'Kalyana', which means 'marriage' or 'beauty'. The name is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who embodies grace, beauty, and prosperity. Kalyaani is believed to bring happiness, wealth, and blessings to her bearer.
